children: Mexico is planning to buy more goods from the United States and reduce imports from other nations as part of the review of the US-Mexico-Canada (USMCA) trade agreement, President Claudia Sheinbaum said on Monday.
"The United States is asking for its so-called trade deficit to be reduced," Sheinbaum said in her daily morning press conference.
